verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's changelog documents a concrete deprecation instance—legacy model names `deepseek-chat`/`deepseek-reasoner` given a dated three-month sunset notice with alias mapping to new models—demonstrating an actual deprecation practice, and the API is versioned via dated model names/updates page. However there is no dedicated, general-purpose 'API versioning & deprecation policy' document laying out SLAs or timelines as a standing policy (only one changelog example is cited). Missing for 10: a formal versioning scheme (e.g., v1/v2 endpoints) and a standalone deprecation-policy page with generalized guarantees beyond one changelog notice.
